subject: Is there something like geom_dotplot in ggvis?

messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: Is there something like geom_dotplot in ggvis?
parts:
Is it possible to make a graph like this with ggvis?

    library(ggplot2)
    ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
      geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center")

Thanks!
